units.source_text: 从相隔七八家的一所滑雪板工厂传来了刨木的声音。

en.t: From a ski factory seven or eight houses away came the sound of wood being planed.

units.source_text: 另一边的屋檐下，有五六个艺妓站着聊天。

en.t: Under the eaves on the other side, five or six geisha stood talking.

units.source_text: 那个女子可能也站在那里。直到今晨才从客栈女侍那里打听到她的艺名叫驹子。

en.t: That woman might be standing there too. Only that morning he had learned from an inn maid that her professional name was Komako.

units.source_text: 果然女子一本正经地瞧着他走过来。

en.t: Sure enough, the woman was watching him come toward her with a very serious face.

units.source_text: 女子必定满脸通红，佯装若无其事的样子，岛村还没这么想，

en.t: Before Shimamura could even think that she would surely blush bright red and pretend nothing was wrong,

units.source_text: 驹子已经连脖子都涨红了。

en.t: Komako had already flushed red even to her neck.

units.source_text: 她本可以背过脸去，但却窘得垂下了视线。

en.t: She could have turned her face away, but instead she lowered her eyes in embarrassment.

units.source_text: 而且，当他走近时，她慢慢地把脸移向他那边去。

en.t: And as he came closer, she slowly turned her face toward him.
